purpose: Planned backbone provenance for V2-G. Populated/verified only once the checkpoints are available and G0 is measured; the estimated fields below are NOT measurements.

environment.hf_reachability: TCP connect OK; HTTPS file download blocked in this agent environment

B0.role: frozen V1 reference (read-only reuse of cache/features)

B1.integration: open_clip build_encoder(model_name=ViT-B-16, pretrained from local .bin); feature_dim forward-probed=512 (same width as B0); native logit scale 100; G1 fully extracted from a 1856-image checkpoint (18136 fresh images in this run).

g1_full_run.crash_and_resume: first run crashed at image 8095 (HF slow SiglipImageProcessor channel-ambiguity TypeError on degenerate batch); fixed at src/ccg/features/backbone.py:encode_images by passing input_data_format='channels_last'; resumed via --resume and adopted the intact 8000-image .tmp (behaviour-preserving for all unambiguous HWC crops).

B2.backbone_choice: spec-literal google/siglip-base-patch16-224 (224px, 768-d) via a new transformers backend; open_clip ViT-B-16-SigLIP reuse was rejected because it would silently substitute a different resolution/objective interface
B2.integration: ccg.features.backbone.build_siglip_encoder (SiglipModel.get_image_features/get_text_features, local_files_only=True), routed through the CLI --backend siglip; end-to-end G1 measured on the full 19992-image frozen bank
resolved_open_items: new transformers SigLIP backend implemented (backbone.py) with dynamic embed_dim; 768-d cache round-trip covered by tests/test_features_cache.py
SigLIP image preprocessing applied from the model's own AutoProcessor (resize 224, mean=std=0.5, bicubic); frozen exact-proposal crop policy still applies at the PIL stage
get_*_features is NOT L2-normalized by default -> explicit l2_normalize before Layer B is applied (l2_normalized=True recorded in metadata)

text tower tokenizer model_max_length=64 -> truncation=True enforced in encode_texts; measured corpus truncation rate = 0/141564 (this RefCOCO+ corpus contains no sentence at/over 64 SigLIP tokens), recorded as provenance

AutoProcessor uses the slow image processor (use_fast unset); the slow path mis-infers channels-first for degenerate batch shapes -> fixed by explicit input_data_format='channels_last' (behaviour-preserving); regression covered by tests/test_features_siglip.py
